summary:

| task-transcript      | true        | true      | false      | 0.509 | ✓                        |
| pure-algorithm       | false       | false     | —          | —     | ⚠️ ON failed (skipped)   |
| pure-refactor        | false       | true      | false      | 0.251 | ✓                        |
| cron-next-fire       | false       | true      | false      | 2.126 | ✓                        |
| lru-cache            | false       | true      | false      | 0.645 | ✓                        |

| write-tests          | false       | true      | false      | 0.830 | ✓                        |
| fix-bug              | false       | true      | false      | 0.866 | ✓                        |
| add-jsdoc            | false       | true      | false      | 0.731 | ✓                        |
| cache-eviction-policy| true        | true      | false      | 0.147 | ✓                        |
| rate-limiter-strategy| —           | —         | —          | —     | ⚠️ skipped (deprecated)  |

Notes:
- pure-algorithm: ON arm only got 2/10 passes, trial auto-skipped by bench harness
- balanced-brackets: OFF solved despite no KB — scenario is too easy for context to matter
- cron-next-fire ratio=2.126 means ON costs MORE than OFF (but ON solved, OFF did not — budget exhausted)
- task-transcript: both runs confirmed ON_solved=true, OFF_solved=false
